instructions.original_snippets: NEVER hand-write a type that a built-in utility already provides
instructions.content: Never hand-write a type that duplicates what Pick, Omit, Partial, or Readonly already provide; a hand-written copy drifts out of sync with the source type.

instructions.original_snippets: Combine utilities rather than inventing a new named type for every combination
instructions.content: Compose built-in utility types directly (e.g. Partial<Omit<T, K>>) rather than inventing a bespoke named type that hides the same composition.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use ReturnType<fn> when you mean ReturnType<typeof fn>
instructions.content: Use typeof when passing a function or class value into a type-extraction utility (ReturnType<typeof fn>, ConstructorParameters<typeof Ctor>), not the value's name directly.

instructions.original_snippets: Extract a constructor's parameter and instance types with ConstructorParameters and InstanceType
instructions.content: Use ConstructorParameters<T> and InstanceType<T> to type a generic factory function's arguments and return value instead of any[] and any.

instructions.original_snippets: Key remapping with an as clause in a mapped type
instructions.content: Use an as clause in a mapped type to remap keys (e.g. renaming foo to getFoo) when generating a derived interface, instead of hand-writing the derived interface.
